subject.title: fix(reef): repeated relay reconnects no longer leave stale sockets active

question: Should Reef prioritize no overlap between failed and replacement sockets even when an unresponsive relay can delay reconnect for the native `ws` close timeout of about 30 seconds?
rationale: This is an intentional channel availability policy trade-off rather than a mechanical defect: removing the delay can reintroduce stale-socket overlap, while retaining it can extend an outage when a peer ignores close.

options.title: Accept bounded reconnect delay
options.body: Merge after an exact-head rebase if Reef intentionally prefers one active generation and allows the native close timeout to bound unresponsive-peer recovery.

options.title: Specify a Reef timeout policy
options.body: Pause for an owner-defined reconnect deadline and corresponding dependency-compatible implementation and proof if 30 seconds is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded reconnect delay
recommendation.body: Merge after an exact-head rebase if Reef intentionally prefers one active generation and allows the native close timeout to bound unresponsive-peer recovery.
